newsitem.title: USA: Medirisk sees Q2 charges of $3.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Medirisk sees Q2 charges of $3.2 mln.

text.p: Medirisk Inc said Tuesday it expected to report about $3.2 million in non-recurring charges for the second quarter following the acquisition of CIVS Inc for cash and stock.
Medirisk said it would incur during the rest of the year an additional $300,000 in non-recurring integration costs.
The company, which develops computer software for the healthcare industry, said it had acquired CIVS Inc for $3.5 million in cash and 129,166 common shares.
CIVS of Rockville, Maryland verifies the credentials of healthcare providers, which must be done every two years, it said.
Medirisk also said it had bought Staff-Link Inc for $330,000. The St. Louis company offers a physician recruitment database for in-house physician recruiting, it added.
